paper_title: MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?
reason: MolP2SBench는 재사용 가능한 새 벤치마크입니다. 136개 과제 패밀리, 11개 속성 채널, 소스 과제 1,496개, 반사실 치환 2,766개로 구성되고 PGR·RM·CFR 지표가 정의되어 있으며, 공식 링크도 PDF가 직접 밝힙니다(github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench). 다만 과제 입력이 SMILES와 계산된 수치(차폐값, 스펙트럼 피크, 쌍극자 등)이고, PDF에는 영어 또는 한국어로 된 프롬프트 템플릿, 지시문, 선택지 인용이 없습니다. 영어로 보이는 문장은 모델이 생성한 설명문이거나 논문 본문뿐이라, 과제 언어를 en 트랙으로 확정할 근거가 부족합니다. 규정상 논문의 서술 언어만으로 데이터셋 언어를 추정할 수 없으므로, 저장소에서 실제 프롬프트 언어를 확인하기 전까지 제안하지 않고 근거 보강이 필요한 것으로 분류합니다.

screening.paper_title: MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?
screening.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in molecular discovery and structure elucidation, where decisions depend on physical observations. Existing evaluations primarily focus on end-to-end molecular reconstruction, where correct predictions do not necessarily indicate reliance on the supplied properties. We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs. Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates. We shuffle or replace properties to test reliance on correct property-structure pairing and responsiveness to counterfactual property changes. A channel-wise leaderboard uses Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR), giving equal weight to source and counterfactual recovery. Evaluating seven models, we find that LLMs can use physical properties for structure prediction, but performance varies substantially across property types. Higher accuracy with a property does not necessarily imply greater responsiveness to it: a model may benefit more from $^1$H NMR than from $^{13}$C NMR, yet be less likely to change its prediction when the $^1$H data is replaced. LLM performance also need not reflect the relative difficulty of these properties for human chemists. Although UV-Vis spectra provide less direct structural information than NMR spectra, Astra achieves higher accuracy with UV-Vis data than with NMR peaks. MolP2SBench supports studying how LLMs extract and use physical-property information, revealing patterns that may differ from conventional chemical intuition and providing a foundation for more reliably property-grounded models for molecular and quantum-chemical inference. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench.
